note: Counts for suites outside the Foundry main suite. The Foundry main suite is read from forge-tests.txt. Each entry names the command that produced its count.

items.label: SDK
items.source: sdk: vitest run --reporter=json, 262 tests (2 more skipped: the opt-in STRIKE_LIVE=1 simulation of v3 register on the two deployed registries, live.consent.test.ts; not counted)

items.label: MCP server
items.source: mcp: vitest run --reporter=json, 90 tests (the devnet suites need Foundry on PATH)

items.label: End-to-end, per viewport
items.source: app: npx playwright test --list reports 876 runs in 43 files = 438 tests x 2 viewports (desktop 1440x900, mobile 390x844), 33 of them the opt-in UI audit (ui-audit.spec.ts, UI_AUDIT=1, desktop only); pure-function and HTTP-only tests (mcp.spec.ts among them) skip the mobile run; the register spec runs its v2 or its 3 v3 tests depending on the devnet's AgentRegistry
